title: heai-tools pod configuration
description: pod.yaml, in the project directory: the runtime, the container's default name, the base image and the extended images built on it, and what every `up` mounts and grants. Every key is optional and an absent file is an empty configuration. tools/pod/README.md is the specification.

runtime.title: apple, docker or podman
runtime.description: The container runtime on the host. Default: apple on macOS, docker elsewhere.

base.title: an image tag
base.description: The base image's tag; what `build base` tags and what extended images are built FROM.

baseDir.title: a path
baseDir.description: The directory holding the base Containerfile, relative to the project directory; the tool's own image/ when unset.

images.title: a mapping of image tag to directory
images.description: Extended images built FROM the base: each key is the tag, each value the directory holding its Containerfile, relative to the project directory.

envFile.title: a path
envFile.description: An env file handed to the runtime unread on `up`; credentials live here, not in an image.

mounts.title: a list of host:container strings
mounts.description: Bind mounts added to every `up`, each `host:container`.

resources.title: a mapping of cpus and memory
resources.description: Limits handed to the runtime when the container is created.
